candidates.explanation: Clear capability colocation, framework-neutral generation operation, capability-shaped provider port, correct Route Handler/SSE lifecycle, upstream cancellation, sliding idle timeout, commit-aware failure transport, and channel-native HTTP/job outcomes. Provider details are contained, redaction is explicit, and unexpected failures have a coherent single-owner/marker strategy.

Strong capability boundary, neutral application operation and port, Route Handler streaming, abort propagation, sliding idle timeout, commit-aware in-band errors, native job outcomes, and provider isolation. Partial credit on shared reporting semantics because the proposal identifies possible duplicate capture by framework instrumentation but leaves the already-reported-marker versus instrumentation-owner choice unresolved.
